scope: Document identity definitions; applicability and compliance remain governed by the project's approved checklist.

omnibus_b.document: Annex B - Documentary Requirements (updated as of June 27 2023).docx

profiles.definition: Bureau of Treasury Notice of Authority to Debit Account Issued identifying the authorized credit of the LGU allocation and value date.
distinguishing_evidence: Notice title, including OCR variants NADAL/NADA
contrasts: An LGU receipt acknowledgement referencing NADAI is not itself the Treasury notice
Credit to an LGU account alone is not proof of subsequent transfer to its trust fund

profiles.definition: Evidence that the LGU allocation has been transferred to or recorded in the LGU trust fund/account, rather than merely received from the National Treasury.
distinguishing_evidence: Explicit transfer to trust fund/account or recording as trust fund
Transfer/deposit/accounting evidence identifying the trust destination
contrasts: A NADAI or general receipt statement alone does not prove trust-fund transfer
A receipt confirmation letter may also substantiate transfer when its body explicitly says so

profiles.definition: Recipient LGU acknowledgement or official receipt confirming that the allocation/subsidy was received.
distinguishing_evidence: LGU or treasurer-issued acknowledgement of received funds
Received allocation, date and reference identifiers
contrasts: A Bureau of Treasury NADAI remains a NADAI despite saying funds were credited
Explicit trust-transfer evidence can make a letter support a separate transfer requirement

profiles.definition: Sanggunian resolution granting authority to implement the project/program or authorizing the appropriate official to act.
distinguishing_evidence: Operative resolved clause authorizing implementation or execution
contrasts: Endorsement, project approval, adoption of a plan or modification alone does not establish implementation authority
Read operative clauses rather than relying only on a title

profiles.definition: Sanggunian resolution approving or endorsing the proposed project or project list.
distinguishing_evidence: Operative approval/endorsement clause and project list
contrasts: An explicit implementation authorization is a distinct checklist item
Annex letters or a reference to another resolution do not determine the operative action

profiles.definition: Approved LDIP/PDIP planning document or relevant portion identifying the included project and planning period.
contrasts: AIP is a separate annual planning document
A letter mentioning LDIP is not necessarily the approved plan portion

profiles.definition: Approved Annual Investment Program or relevant portion showing the project and annual funding/planning entries.
distinguishing_evidence: AIP title and annual investment table
contrasts: LDIP/PDIP is a distinct multi-year planning document
Mention of AIP within a certification is not automatically the plan itself

profiles.definition: Procurement posting/PhilGEPS or bid-evaluation evidence; distinguish the posted invitation from award and proceed notices.
distinguishing_evidence: Reference or solicitation number, procurement classification, publication/closing dates
For evaluation records, explicit bid-opening/evaluation content
contrasts: Goods procurement is a specific subtype; if both broad and specific slots are offered, compare their scope without inventing equivalence
An ITB is not a NOA or NTP

profiles.definition: Notice authorizing the contractor to commence the awarded contracted work/procurement.
distinguishing_evidence: Contractor, awarded contract/project and commencement instruction
contrasts: SGLG-IF Notice to Implement is a distinct program-issued authorization
A letter permitting procurement to start is not automatically a contractor NTP

profiles.definition: SGLG-IF program-issued Notice to Implement, distinct from a procurement contractor's Notice to Proceed.
distinguishing_evidence: Notice to Implement title and SGLG-IF program context
Regional issuance authorizing the LGU project
contrasts: Omnibus Annex E means deficiencies notice; SGLG-IF Annex E means NTI
A contractor's NTP is a different document

profiles.definition: Program of Works specifying work items, quantities, unit costs and the project estimate.
contrasts: Detailed unit price analysis explains unit-rate components
A physical accomplishment report describes executed rather than proposed work

profiles.definition: Detailed engineering design/drawing/specification evidence defining the proposed works.
contrasts: POW or DUPA alone is not the complete design
Design completeness belongs to compliance review

profiles.definition: Certificate of final acceptance after the applicable defects-liability stage.
contrasts: Completion, delivery acceptance or turnover at completion is not automatically post-DLP final acceptance

profiles.definition: Certification that the project works have been completed according to the plans/specifications.
distinguishing_evidence: Project, completion date and certifying party
contrasts: Omnibus Annex G is COC; SGLG-IF Annex G is SORD
Initial turnover/acceptance and post-DLP final acceptance are distinct evidence roles

profiles.definition: Financial statement itemizing fund receipts and disbursements for the project and reporting period.
contrasts: SWA describes physical work accomplishment
SGLG-IF Annex G is SORD, whereas Omnibus Annex G is completion certification

profiles.definition: Statement of physical works accomplished, with work items/quantities and accomplishment for the reporting period; final SWA is the final version.
contrasts: SORD is financial receipts/disbursements
POW is a proposed works/estimate document

profiles.definition: Visual evidence documenting the project/site or activity; a photo-only document may have no readable OCR text.
distinguishing_evidence: Captions, geotags, milestones or before/during/after context where available
contrasts: No readable text is insufficient to infer the photographed project identity
A narrative progress report mentioning photos is not the photo evidence itself
